# L1′ — Phenomenal

**MEF lens `L1′`** · Square B — Encounter `[1 + 4]`: cause ⇄ experience, structure ⇄ investigation · Night face · index `#1′` · tonic `D♯` · ground-pair **Need** (Power-led) · twin: [L1 — Causal](L1-causal.md)

*Root:* Jung's psychic functions · *Element:* Water · *Möbius:* `L1′ → L4`

The same Mind/Need rotation grounded on the Power-face: not the objective structure of cause but the felt immediacy of lack — qualia, the subjective undergoing.

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L1.0′ — Introversion** (`Need[D♯]` / `Mind[D]`) — the inward orientation, libido toward the unconscious pole.

- **L1.1′ — Sensation** (`Sacrifice[F]` / `Word[E]`) — immediate perception, the "thereness"; irrational/non-judging.

- **L1.2′ — Feeling** (`Decision[G]` / `Logos[F♯]`) — evaluative function, assigning worth; rational/judging.

- **L1.3′ — Thinking** (`Love[A]` / `Son[G♯]`) — analytical function, logical classification; rational/judging.

- **L1.4′ — Intuition** (`Work[B]` / `Image[A♯]`) — perception of possibilities and hidden connections; irrational/non-judging.

- **L1.5′ — Extroversion** (`Play[C♯]` / `Truth[C]`) — the outward orientation, libido invested in the world.


## Derivation at this index

*Shares `L1`'s 8-fold and diatonic* — sounding Word·Logos·Son·Image + Sacrifice·Decision·Love·Work; anchors Mind, Truth, Need, Play; diatonic Mind–Word–Logos · Decision–Love–Work–Play.

*Reading:* grounded on Need, the typology is inhabited from inside the wanting; the Name hexad (Mind→Truth) is the structure the feeling is read through.
